bottleneck.description: Qualified Tesla supplier for EV thermal management valves, expansion valves, and electronic pumps; designated for Tesla Optimus actuator joints.

dependency.key_customers: Tesla, BYD, Volkswagen, Geely, Daikin, Midea, Gree
dependency.key_suppliers: Steel/brass alloy mills, rare earth magnet suppliers (CNRE downstream)

editorial.notes: Sanhua is a leading global supplier of HVAC/refrigeration valves and a designated Tesla Tier-1 for NEV thermal management (~RMB 1,300/vehicle in Model 3). Switching costs are real in EV TMS where Sanhua has multi-year qualification with major OEMs, and the Tesla Optimus actuator partnership adds humanoid optionality. However, alternatives exist (Danfoss, DunAn, Saginomiya) in refrigeration valves, so this is qualification-friction MEDIUM rather than monopoly HIGH.
